animal.en: I see an animal in the zoo.
animal.zh: 我在动物园里看到一只动物。

panda.en: The panda likes to eat bamboo.

elephant.en: The elephant has a long nose.

bear.en: The bear is sleeping in the cave.

giraffe.en: The giraffe has a very long neck.

him.en: I see him at the park.

lion.en: The lion is big and strong.

zoo.en: We see pandas at the zoo.

go.en: I go to bed at nine.

zebra.en: I see a zebra at the zoo.
zebra.zh: 我在动物园看到一只斑马。

road.en: The bus is on the road.

dance.en: I like to dance with my friends.

along.en: Let's sing along to the song.

word.en: This word is new to me.
word.zh: 这个单词对我来说是新的。

hat.en: My hat is red and blue.
hat.zh: 我的帽子是红蓝相间的。

head.en: I have a head and a face.

eye.en: I can see with my eye.

ear.en: I hear music with my ear.

nose.en: I smell a flower with my nose.

leg.en: I can kick with my leg.

child.en: The child plays with a ball.

work.en: Dad goes to work by bus.

snowman.en: We make a snowman in winter.
snowman.zh: 我们在冬天堆一个雪人。

long.en: The snake has a long body.

rock.en: I find a small rock on the road.
rock.zh: 我在路上找到一块小石头。

part.en: My arm is a body part.
part.zh: 我的胳膊是一个身体部位。

hear.en: I can hear a bird sing.

smell.en: I smell the flower in the garden.

talk.en: We talk with our friends at school.
talk.zh: 我们在学校和朋友们说话。

eat.en: I eat an apple every day.

dream.en: I had a fun dream last night.
dream.zh: 昨晚我做了一个有趣的梦。

food.en: I have yummy food for lunch.

strawberry.en: I like to eat a red strawberry.
strawberry.zh: 我喜欢吃一颗红色的草莓。

tomato.en: I put a tomato in my salad.
tomato.zh: 我在沙拉里放了一个番茄。

noodles.en: Mom cooks long noodles for me.
noodles.zh: 妈妈给我煮长长的面条。

carrot.en: The rabbit eats a carrot for snack.
carrot.zh: 兔子吃一根胡萝卜当点心。

chicken.en: I have chicken and rice for dinner.

fish.en: The cat likes to eat fish.

rice.en: I eat white rice with my family.
rice.zh: 我和家人一起吃白米饭。

meat.en: Dad puts meat in the soup.

fruit.en: I eat a fruit every morning.
fruit.zh: 我每天早上吃一个水果。

vegetable.en: I eat a green vegetable for health.
vegetable.zh: 我吃一种绿色蔬菜为了健康。

salad.en: I make a salad with tomatoes.

banana.en: I eat a banana every morning.
banana.zh: 我每天早上吃一根香蕉。

cucumber.en: I like cucumber in my salad.

then.en: First wash, then eat the apple.

what about....en: What about a glass of milk?

grape.en: I have a purple grape for you.

juice.en: Orange juice is my favorite drink.
juice.zh: 橙汁是我最喜欢的饮料。

early.en: I wake up early on school days.

breakfast.en: We eat breakfast at seven o'clock.

time.en: It is time to go to school.

still.en: I still have my toy car.

question.en: I have a question for you.

mantis.en: I see a green mantis on the leaf.
mantis.zh: 我在叶子上看到一只绿色的螳螂。

grow.en: The small plant will grow tall.

grow up.en: I want to be a doctor when I grow up.

robot.en: My toy robot can walk and talk.
robot.zh: 我的玩具机器人会走路和说话。

kite.en: We fly a kite in the park.

skate.en: I learn to skate on the lake.

ice.en: The ice is cold and hard.

ski.en: I ski down the hill with Dad.
ski.zh: 我和爸爸一起滑雪下山。

garden.en: We plant flowers in the garden.

swim.en: I can swim in the pool.

lot.en: I have a lot of toys.

tai chi.en: Grandpa does tai chi in the park.

insect.en: I see a small insect on the leaf.
insect.zh: 我看到叶子上有一只小昆虫。

subject.zh: 我最喜欢的学科是美术。

card.en: I make a card for you.

busy.en: My mum is very busy today.

bookmark.en: I put my bookmark in the book.

stick.en: I found a long stick in the park.
stick.zh: 我在公园里找到一根长木棍。

sure.en: Sure, I can help you clean up.

flower.en: I picked a red flower for my mom.
flower.zh: 我给妈妈摘了一朵红花。

afterschool.en: We have an afterschool art class.
afterschool.zh: 我们有一节课外美术课。

club.en: I join the drawing club at school.
club.zh: 我参加了学校的绘画俱乐部。

piano.en: My sister plays the piano every day.

basketball.en: I like to play basketball after class.

computer.en: I use a computer to learn English.

music.en: I listen to music before bed.

past.en: It is ten past three in the afternoon.

half past one / two....en: We eat lunch at half past twelve.

homework.en: I do my homework after dinner.

need.en: I need a pencil for class.

activity.en: We have a fun activity today.
activity.zh: 我们今天有一个有趣的活动。

class.en: We sing in class every day.

evening.en: I read a book in the evening.

call.en: I call my grandma on Sunday.
call.zh: 星期天我给奶奶打电话。

clock.en: The clock on the wall is big.

half.en: I ate half of the cake.

afternoon tea.en: We have afternoon tea at four.

every.en: I read a book every day.

tree.en: The bird is in the tree.

sandwich.en: I eat a sandwich for lunch.

beef.en: My mom cooks beef for dinner.

hot.en: The soup is hot, be careful.

hot dog.en: I want a hot dog for snack.
hot dog.zh: 我想要一个热狗当零食。

sushi.zh: 寿司是我最喜欢的食物。

cake.en: I have a cake on my birthday.

Monday.en: Monday is the first school day.
Monday.zh: 星期一是第一个上学日。

Tuesday.en: We have art class on Tuesday.

Wednesday.en: Wednesday is in the middle of the week.

Thursday.en: I have a music lesson on Thursday.
Thursday.zh: 我星期四有一节音乐课。

Friday.en: We can play football after school on Friday.
Friday.zh: 我们星期五放学后可以踢足球。

Saturday.en: I go to the park with my mom on Saturday.
Saturday.zh: 我星期六和妈妈去公园。

Sunday.en: We visit my grandma on Sunday.
Sunday.zh: 我们星期日去看望奶奶。

park.en: The park is near my school.

visit.en: I visit my friend on Saturday.
visit.zh: 我星期六拜访我的朋友。

lesson.en: We have a football lesson today.
lesson.zh: 我们今天有一节足球课。

football.en: I like to play football in the park.
football.zh: 我喜欢在公园里踢足球。
